items.title: Two killed in explosion of ammunition-laden vehicle in Syria’s Idlib
items.summary: Several people injured in the incident that took place in the Idlib countryside, state media reports.

items.title: Tajik envoy: Dushanbe does not support anti-Iran sanctions
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Ambassador of Tajikistan in Iran Zahidi Nizomiddin Shamsiddinzoda has stressed his country’s opposition to sanctions against Iran.

items.title: General Assembly, 110th Meeting (AM) 1 September 2026
items.summary: At 10 a.m., the General Assembly will hold a debate on the situation in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine, in which over 30 representatives are expected to take the floor, including those from Ukraine and the Russian Federation.

items.title: Pezeshkian, Xi hold brief talks on sidelines of SCO summit
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping have held a brief meeting on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

items.title: Iran condemns US attack on Larak Island in letter to UN
items.summary: New York, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador and deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, Gholamhossein Darzi, has strongly condemned the latest US aggression against Larak Island in a letter to the UN secretary-general and Security Council president.

items.title: Transfer deadline day live: Premier League, La Liga news and done deals
items.summary: Live updates and news from all signings as Premier League targets Alvarez, Balogun and Gakpo are expected to move.

items.title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least four, including children
items.summary: At least three killed and several wounded in an Israeli air attack in the al-Kateeba district west of Gaza City.

items.title: Araghchi holds talks with his counterparts on SCO Summit sidelines
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has met with his Russian, Pakistani, Tajik, Uzbek, and Kazakh counterparts on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit in Bishkek.

items.title: Russian drone and missile barrage kills at least 12 in Ukraine’s Kyiv
items.summary: Russian attacks escalate as EU defence ministers meet in Ireland to discuss Ukraine air defence shortages.

items.title: Could 4+4 make 1 in Libya? UN-backed agreement looks to unite rival camps
items.summary: After 15 years of civil war, a new UN-backed '4+4' agreement looks to unite Libya's rival factions.
